# `react/workspace/ChartWorkspace`

One component and three required prop groups: what may be drawn, where the numbers come
from, how much height it may use. Everything else is optional and additive — chrome, panes, studies,
drawing, patterns, tabs — and each absent group leaves a working default rather than a hole.

## Example

```tsx
import { ChartWorkspace, type ChartWorkspaceProps } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

export function Workspace(props: ChartWorkspaceProps) {
  return <ChartWorkspace {...props} />;
}
```

## `ChartWorkspaceProps`

Derived from the interface and from the destructuring in the component, so a default that
changes in the code changes here.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `catalogue` | `WorkspaceSetupPolicy` | yes | — |
| `data` | `WorkspaceDataSource` | yes | — |
| `layout` | `WorkspaceLayoutBudget` | yes | — |
| `chrome` | `WorkspaceChromeOptions \| undefined` | no | — |
| `panes` | `readonly PaneSpec[] \| undefined` | no | — |
| `studies` | `WorkspaceStudies \| undefined` | no | — |
| `drawing` | `WorkspaceDrawingOptions \| undefined` | no | — |
| `patterns` | `readonly CandlePatternChoice[] \| undefined` | no | — |
| `tabs` | `WorkspaceTabsOptions \| undefined` | no | — |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | no | — |
